name: Razor-Feather Barrage (Recharge 5-6)
description: The creature launches a barrage of razor-sharp feathers in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
